name: Keel Desktop

windows.name: Windows x64 (64-bit)
windows.notes: Not publicly hosted yet; there is nothing to download. Installers will appear here after verification.
windows.installation: Run Keel-Setup-0.1.1.exe. Accept the installer prompts. Launch Keel from the Start Menu or Desktop shortcut.

macos.name: macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon)
macos.notes: Not publicly hosted yet; there is nothing to download. Installers will appear here after verification.
macos.installation: Open the DMG, drag Keel into Applications, then right-click Keel and choose Open the first time (Gatekeeper).

linux.name: Linux x86_64
linux.notes: Not publicly hosted yet; there is nothing to download. Installers will appear here after verification.
linux.installation: Make the AppImage executable and run it. On Debian/Ubuntu the .deb can be installed with your package manager instead.

__hosting__: No public installer has been published yet. Installers will appear on the official download page only after their SHA-256 checksums have been verified over public HTTPS.
